items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I don't think Reuben Rubin cared too much for Louie Armstrong's popularity.

ctx.x: And they had all the bally-hoo they could get together at that time to welcome Rubin Reed Reuben Reeves back to Chicago. Shortly, almost the same time they did the same thing with Louie Armstrong, so that was I think a little feeling between the -- I mean not on Louie's side, but I don't think Reuben Rubin cared too much for Louie Armstrong's popularity. I don't think so. But Louie came just maybe say on the tailend of Rubin Reed's Reuben Reeves return and then you didn't hear anymore of Rubin Reed Reuben Reeves.
